implemented_scope: Glossed Magma is registered with the imported age=0..3 state and the vanilla Magma Block gameplay template.
Random-tick callbacks draw synchronously from the active Level RNG; Glossed Magma consumes nextInt(9) before checking its adjacent-block count.
Glossed Magma advances ages, schedules its next check after 20–40 ticks, melts age 3 to source lava, and propagates the audited neighbor-melt branch.
Neighbor changes convert Glossed Magma to lava below the audited two-neighbor threshold.
Glossed Magma declares hot_floor step damage with the vanilla 1.0 amount and sneak suppression.
The imported empty Glossed Magma loot table is preserved.
